_comment: Minimal config: only language + per-item {prompt, answer} are required (legacy {en, fr} still accepted). build.sh derives q/a (cadence), q_text ('How do we say <prompt> in <language>?'), a_text (answer + terminal '.'), and total_seconds. prompt/answer must each be ≤44 chars. flags = ISO-3166 alpha-2 codes -> real flag images (list of one = single flag); omit for the legacy tricolor. fonts = extra webfont files in assets/fonts/ for non-Latin scripts.
outro: Follow me to learn French every day
